arguments.query: FROM logs-k8s-* | WHERE kubernetes.labels.app == "payment-service" | EVAL window = CASE(@timestamp >= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-26T10:01:43Z"), "current", "baseline") | EVAL is_start = CASE(message LIKE "Starting*", 1, 0) | STATS count = COUNT(*), starts = SUM(is_start), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp) BY window, version = version

FROM logs-k8s-* | WHERE kubernetes.labels.app == "payment-service" | WHERE @timestamp >= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-26T10:01:43Z") AND message LIKE "Database connection timeout: could not acquire a connection from the pool within*" | KEEP @timestamp, trace_id, version | SORT @timestamp ASC | LIMIT 5

tools.description: List the log indices you are allowed to query, with document counts and sizes.
tools.name: list_indices

tools.description: Field names and types for an index pattern, e.g. 'payment-prod-*'.
tools.name: get_mapping

tools.description:
Return sample log documents.

        Args:
            index: allowed index pattern, e.g. 'payment-prod-*'.
            start: window start, ISO-8601 UTC (e.g. '2026-09-25T10:00:00Z').
            end: window end, ISO-8601 UTC.
            query: optional Lucene query, e.g. 'message:"connection timeout" AND status_code:500'.
            levels: optional log levels, e.g. ['ERROR', 'WARN'].
            size: max documents to return (capped by the server).
            sort: 'desc' = newest first, 'asc' = oldest first (use asc to find first occurrence).
            fields: optional list of fields to return.
tools.name: search_logs

tools.description:
Run a read-only ES|QL query, automatically limited to [start, end].

        The query must start with 'FROM <allowed index pattern>'. Example:
          FROM payment-prod-* | WHERE level == "ERROR"
          | STATS count = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp) BY error_type | SORT count DESC
        Args:
            query: ES|QL query.
            start: window start, ISO-8601 UTC.
            end: window end, ISO-8601 UTC.
tools.name: execute_esql
